# Enumerations

## <a id="BehaviourLaw"></a>BehaviourLaw

How the stress in a material follows its strain.

- **Introduced in:** version 3

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `linear_elastic` | Stress proportional to strain, in tension and compression. |
| `concrete_parabola_rectangle` | The parabola-rectangle diagram for concrete in compression (EN 1992-1-1, 3.1.7). |
| `concrete_bilinear` | The bi-linear diagram for concrete in compression (EN 1992-1-1, 3.1.7(2)). |
| `steel_bilinear` | Linear up to yield, then a hardening or horizontal branch (EN 1992-1-1, 3.2.7; EN 1993-1-1, 5.4.3). |
| `timber_elastic_brittle` | Linear up to the strength, brittle in tension and plastic in compression, for timber parallel to the grain (EN 1995-1-1). |
| `none` | No structural behaviour: the material carries no stress in design. |

## <a id="MaterialCategory"></a>MaterialCategory

What a material is; it decides which properties it gives and which behaviour laws suit it.

- **Introduced in:** version 3

| Item | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `concrete` | Concrete (EN 1992-1-1). |
| `reinforcement` | Steel bars and meshes for reinforced concrete (EN 1992-1-1). |
| `steel` | Structural steel for members and plates (EN 1993-1-1). |
| `timber` | Solid timber and glued laminated timber (EN 1995-1-1, EN 338, EN 14080). |
| `masonry` | Masonry units laid in mortar (EN 1996-1-1). |
| `insulation` | Thermal and acoustic insulation, such as mineral wool or expanded polystyrene; no structural use. |
| `finish` | Linings, renders, plasters and claddings; no structural use. |
| `generic` | Any other material. |
